chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Abdullah ibn Musa, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:

I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “Indeed, for the boy there will be a ghaybah (occultation) before he rises.” He said: I said, “And why?” He said: “He fears,” and he gestured with his hand toward his stomach.

Then he said: “O Zurarah, and he is al-Muntazar, and he is the one regarding whose birth doubt will arise. Among them is one who says: ‘His father died without a successor’; and among them is one who says: ‘A pregnancy’; and among them is one who says: ‘Indeed, he was born two years before the death of his father.’ And he is al-Muntazar, except that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, loves to test the Shi'ah. So at that time, the falsifiers will fall into doubt, O Zurarah.”

He said: I said, “May I be made your ransom, if I reach that time, what should I do?” He said: “O Zurarah, if you reach this time, then supplicate with this du'a: ‘O Allah, make me know Yourself, for if You do not make me know Yourself, I will not know Your Prophet. O Allah, make me know Your Messenger, for if You do not make me know Your Messenger, I will not know Your Hujjah. O Allah, make me know Your Hujjah, for if You do not make me know Your Hujjah, I will go astray from my religion.’”

Then he said: “O Zurarah, there must inevitably be the killing of a boy in al-Madinah.” I said, “May I be made your ransom, is it not the army of al-Sufyani that will kill him?” He said: “No, rather the army of the family of so-and-so will kill him. It will come until it enters al-Madinah, then seize the boy and kill him. So when they kill him in rebellion, hostility, and ظلم, they will not be granted respite. Then at that moment, await the faraj, if Allah wills.”

key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: the supplication taught for that time
key_terms.الْغُلَامِ: the boy, referring here to the awaited Imam
key_terms.الْفَرَجِ: relief; the divinely granted deliverance associated with the Imam's rise
key_terms.حُجَّتَكَ: Your Hujjah; the divine proof of Allah upon creation
key_terms.غَيْبَةً: occultation; a period of concealment before the Imam's rise
key_terms.وِلَادَتِهِ: his birth, concerning which people will dispute
key_terms.يَمْتَحِنَ: to test; Allah testing the Shi'ah through the circumstances

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach for the time of the ghaybah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the ghaybah (occultation) of the awaited Imam and the confusion that will surround his birth and identity as a trial for the Shi'ah. It teaches a foundational du'a for steadfast recognition of Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and His Hujjah, and it also mentions a sign preceding the faraj.
